kindHint.1: Window: bids are collected until the close time, then allocated by the chosen policy. Requires a venue with a bound contract.
kindHint.2: Tap: standing offer at a fixed price, filled first-come until the amount is exhausted.
kindHint.3: Auction: priced bids are collected until the close time, then one clearing price is struck at or above the reserve. Requires a venue with a bound contract.
